framework.name: Digital Personal Data Protection Act 2023 (DPDP)
framework.description: Indian statutory framework establishing obligations for Data Fiduciaries, Data Principals' rights, consent management, data breach notifications to DPBI, and stringent penalties for non-compliance.

controls.title: Itemized Consent Notice & Purpose Specification
controls.description: Data Fiduciaries must give clear, itemized notice in plain language (and scheduled languages) detailing personal data collected and specified purpose before or at consent request.

controls.title: Free and Explicit Consent Revocation Mechanism
controls.description: Data Principals must be provided an easy, accessible mechanism to withdraw consent at any time with ease comparable to giving consent.

controls.title: Verifiable Parental Consent for Minors & Persons with Disabilities
controls.description: Processing personal data of children or persons with disabilities requires verifiable parental/guardian consent without tracking or targeted ads.

controls.title: Strict Data Minimization & Collection Scoping
controls.description: Personal data collection must be restricted strictly to data necessary for specified and lawful purposes.

controls.title: Mandatory Data Erasure & Retention Purging
controls.description: Data Fiduciaries must erase personal data as soon as consent is withdrawn or specified purpose is served, unless retention is mandated by law.

controls.title: Data Principal Right to Summary of Data & Processing Entities
controls.description: Data Principals have the right to request a summary of personal data being processed and identity of all Data Fiduciaries/Processors shared with.

controls.title: Right to Correction, Completion, and Updating of PII
controls.description: Data Fiduciaries must maintain accurate personal data and provide self-service or assisted mechanisms for data principals to correct or update records.

controls.title: Grievance Redressal Mechanism & SLA Enforcement
controls.description: Data Fiduciaries must establish an accessible grievance redressal mechanism with published contact details and defined resolution timelines.

controls.title: Mandatory Data Breach Notification to DPBI & Data Principals
controls.description: In the event of a personal data breach, Data Fiduciaries must notify the Data Protection Board of India (DPBI) and affected Data Principals without delay.

controls.title: Encryption of PII at Rest and in Transit
controls.description: Technical and organizational measures must enforce AES-256 encryption for PII stored at rest and TLS 1.2+ for PII transmitted over networks.

controls.title: Access Control & Role-Based Least Privilege for PII Assets
controls.description: Access to databases and cloud storage containing PII must be restricted strictly via Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) and Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA).

controls.title: PII Audit Logging & Tamper-Evident Trail Preservation
controls.description: All access, modification, and deletion events involving personal data must generate tamper-evident audit logs preserved for a minimum retention window.

controls.title: Data Protection Officer (DPO) Designation & Statutory Governance
controls.description: Significant Data Fiduciaries must appoint a resident Data Protection Officer based in India who reports directly to executive management.

controls.title: Periodic Data Protection Audit & Independent Auditor Review
controls.description: Significant Data Fiduciaries must undergo independent periodic data protection audits by certified privacy auditors.

controls.title: Data Protection Impact Assessment (DPIA) Execution
controls.description: Significant Data Fiduciaries must carry out DPIA before deploying high-risk data processing activities or algorithm modifications.

controls.title: Third-Party Data Processor Due Diligence & Contractual Binding
controls.description: Personal data sharing with third-party Data Processors must occur solely under valid Data Processing Agreements (DPA) enforcing security safeguards.
